params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Prowl:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, {{ci|Nidalee}} becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a short time, increased when facing a nearby enemy {{tip|champion}}. These bonuses briefly persist after exiting brush.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Hunt:}} Hitting nearby {{tip|monsters}} or enemy champions with ''{{ai|Javelin Toss|Nidalee}}'' or ''{{ai|Bushwhack|Nidalee}}'' will apply a ''Hunted'' mark and {{tip|true sight|reveal}} them for a few seconds. During this time, '''Nidalee''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, increased when facing a ''Hunted'' target.
params.blurb3: '''Nidalee's''' first use of ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}}'' and ''{{ai|Pounce|Nidalee}}'' against ''Hunted'' targets are empowered.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Prowl:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Nidalee''' gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while facing a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}} within 1400 range. The bonuses persist for 2 seconds after leaving brush.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Hunt:}} Hitting enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|monsters}} with ''{{ai|Javelin Toss|Nidalee}}'' or ''{{ai|Bushwhack|Nidalee}}'' applies a ''Hunted'' mark to the target for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} as well as grant {{tip|sight}} of a 300-unit radius around them. If '''Nidalee''' is nearby when the target is hit, she gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}} for 4 seconds, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while she is facing a ''Hunted'' target. Additionally, the first cast of both ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}}'' and ''{{ai|Pounce|Nidalee}}'' against a ''Hunted'' target is enhanced.
params.description3: The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} from ''Prowl'' and ''Hunt'' can stack, but cannot exceed {{as|30%|ms}}.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|3000|Range for granting Nidalee Hunt's movement speed bonus}}|{{tt|5500|Hunt increased bonus movement speed range when facing Hunted targets}}}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nidalee}} hurls a javelin in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit based on distance travelled.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' hurls a javelin in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 225 for 6|525 to 1300}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 150}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3.25 to 150*3.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*3.25}}% AP)}}}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Nidalee}} next {{tip|basic attack}} within some time will gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}} Bonus:}} A ''Hunted'' target hit will take {{ccs|increased damage|magic}}.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 10 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}} that is increased by an amount for every {{as|1% of the target's '''missing''' health}}.

''Takedown'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Nidalee|crit_base}}|100|base = 100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunt}}'' Bonus:}} Hitting a ''Hunted'' target {{ccs|increases|magic}} ''Takedown's'' damage by 30%.
params.description3: ''Takedown {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nidalee's''' basic attack timer. Other damage converted to {{as|magic damage}} by Takedown are not increased by Takedown's respective effects. '''Nidalee''' loses Takedown's empowered attack immediately when she switches to {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee|Human Form}}.''
params.notes:
* ''Takedown's'' attack deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* ''Takedown's'' damage is not affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers, but the basic attack can still critically strike and the '''bonus''' damage from the critical strike is converted to {{as|magic damage}}.
** ''Takedown's'' damage modifier does not affect the '''bonus''' damage dealt by the critical strike.
* ''Takedown'' converts the '''bonus''' damage dealt by {{tip|Spellblade}} to {{as|magic damage}} from {{as|physical|physical damage}}, but does not apply its damage modifier to the effect.
* ''Takedown's'' damage will apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
* ''Takedown's'' damage modifier does not apply against structures; the minimum damage is always applied.
* {{pending for test}} - Parry interactions ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}} and {{tip|blind}}).

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nidalee}} lays a {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} that will spring upon contact with an enemy, continually dealing {{as|magic damage}} over a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' lays a trap at the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over {{fd|1.5}} seconds, lasting for up to 120 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} within its radius. The trap will spring upon contact with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds.
params.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|10*4 to 50*4}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
params.description2: Traps have {{as|{{sti|health|6 '''maximum''' health}}}} and can only be damaged by champion [[basic attacks]] (2 hit points from {{tip|ranged}} and 3 hit points from {{tip|melee}}). Up to a maximum of {{pp|4 to 10 for 4|1 to 16}} traps may be active at once.
params.notes: * ''Bushwhack'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} Killing an enemy or using ''Pounce's'' ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' bonus will {{sti|cdr|reduce}} ''Pounce's'' cooldown.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nidalee}} dashes in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies upon arrival.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' Bonus:}} ''Pounce'' has increased range when cast near ''Hunted'' targets.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Killing an enemy while in ''Cougar Form'' or using ''Pounce's Hunt'' bonus reduces ''Pounce's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to a minimum value.
params.leveling:
{{sbc|''{{ai|Pounce|Nidalee}}'' scales with ''{{ais|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}}'' rank}}
{{st|Reduced Cooldown|{{tt|{{ap|3 to 1.5 4}} seconds|Affected by ability haste}}}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} a fixed distance in the target direction. Upon arrival, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description3: {{sbc|''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' Bonus:}} '''Nidalee''' can perform ''Pounce'' from an increased range on a ''Hunted'' enemy closest to the cursor. She will leap to the front of the target.
params.description4: ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}} and {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}} can be cast during the dash.''
params.outofrange: If targeting a ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' enemy, the ability will cast in its [[direction-targeted]] version.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nidalee}} revitalizes herself or the target allied champion, granting {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds and {{tip|healing}} the target based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' revitalizes herself or the target allied champion, granting the target {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 7 seconds and {{tip|healing}} them for an amount that is increased by {{as|{{pp|label1=target's '''missing''' health|label=Heal increase|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 95|formula=1% per 0.95% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}}
{{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|50*2 to 150*2}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
params.notes: * The {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} will persist through {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar 2|Nidalee|Cougar Form}} if '''Nidalee''' uses ''Primal Surge'' on herself.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nidalee}} slashes in an arc in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' slashes in an arc in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.leveling:
{{sbc|''{{ai|Swipe|Nidalee}}'' scales with ''{{ais|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}}'' rank}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 250 4}} {{as|(+ 70% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nidalee}} switches between her '''Human Form''' and '''Cougar Form'''.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|[[File:Aspect of the Cougar.png|20px|link=|border]] Cougar Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a cougar, gaining {{tip|melee}} attacks and access to her cougar abilities.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|[[File:Aspect of the Cougar 2.png|20px|link=|border]] Human Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} attacks and access to her human abilities. While in '''Human Form''', applying a ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' mark will {{sti|cdr|reset}} ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' cooldown.
params.blurb4: '''Nidalee''' begins with one rank in ''Aspect of the Cougar''. '''Cougar Form's''' abilities scale based on ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' rank.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' switches between her {{sbc|Human Form}} and {{sbc|Cougar Form}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Cougar Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a cougar, gaining {{tip|melee}} attacks with {{sti|range|125 range}} and access to her cougar abilities.
params.description3: {{sbc|Human Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} attacks with {{sti|range|525 range}} and access to her human abilities. While in this form, applying a ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' mark will reset ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
params.description5: '''Nidalee''' begins with one rank in ''Aspect of the Cougar'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16. {{sbc|Cougar Form's}} abilities scale based on ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' rank.
params.notes: *Transformations do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
